items.title: Clarify Image Models in Skills Documentation 📝
items.summary: This update removes the misleading `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` from the AI chat model documentation. It adds a clear note stating that image-generating models are not compatible with chat endpoints, directing users to the appropriate endpoints for image generation. This change aims to prevent incorrect model usage and improve user experience.

items.title: Fix fallback issue with image model in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the image model `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` from the text fallback chain, preventing guaranteed failures during upstream outages. Additionally, two new tests were added to ensure that image models are not used as text fallbacks and do not have their own fallback chains. Overall, this enhances the reliability of the model fallback mechanism.

items.title: Fix import order issues in Backend ⚙️
items.summary: This update resolves import order issues in two test files that caused failures when the DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE environment variable was not set. The DRF imports have been moved to ensure they are loaded after the Django setup, preventing collection errors. Additionally, a new guard has been added to automatically scan for similar issues in all test files, enhancing overall test reliability.

items.title: Fix WeChat API Issues and Enhance Features in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves critical issues with the WeChat API integration, including the removal of outdated endpoints that caused 404 errors. Key enhancements include the introduction of real @-mentions in messages, improved command handling, and new commands for managing Moments and group chats. Comprehensive testing has been implemented to ensure stability and functionality.

items.title: Enhanced Domain Review Process in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical issues identified during the first production run. The agent now correctly references the database for blocked domains, preventing previously blocked domains from being re-evaluated. Additionally, the job failure logic has been refined to ensure successful runs are not marked as failures due to agent timeouts, improving overall reliability.

items.title: Enhance Heartbeat Mechanism to Prevent Socket Failures in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a proactive heartbeat mechanism for the extension, sending a heartbeat every 20 seconds to prevent the service worker from being evicted due to inactivity. Key changes include modifications to the device relay and reconnect alarm logic, ensuring the socket remains active and reducing the risk of silent disconnections. Additionally, new tests have been added to validate the heartbeat functionality and ensure robust performance.

items.title: Sync Check Blocked for Suno Due to Missing OpenAPI Source in Clis 🚫
items.summary: The sync process for the `suno` CLI package was halted because the necessary OpenAPI source file, `openapi/suno.json`, is absent from the repository. This missing specification prevents safe code changes and requires either the addition of the OpenAPI file or equivalent content from `AceDataCloud/Docs` to proceed. Verification checks confirmed the absence of the required files.

items.title: Clarify duration variability in APIs 🤖
items.summary: This update enhances the documentation for the audio generation API by clarifying that the duration of generated tracks can vary significantly between requests. It emphasizes that the duration parameter serves as a hint rather than a strict limit, and actual lengths may differ. Key changes were made to the integration guide to reflect these insights.

items.title: Sync suno MCP with latest Docs updates in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the `suno` MCP server with recent changes from the Docs/OpenAPI specifications. Key improvements include syncing tool definitions, updating request parameters, and ensuring response schemas reflect the latest documentation. Backward compatibility is maintained by extending accepted model values.

items.title: Fix missing required fields in Anthropic Messages response in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses two critical compliance issues in the Anthropic Messages API. It ensures that the `citations` field is included in the response text block and modifies the handling of `cache_read_input_tokens` and `cache_creation_input_tokens` to meet the required specifications. Additionally, several tests have been updated to reflect these changes, improving overall API reliability.

items.title: Update documentation on duration variability in Backend 🎶
items.summary: This update enhances the documentation regarding the `duration` parameter for audio generation, clarifying that it serves as a guideline rather than a strict limit. It highlights that identical requests may yield significantly different durations, emphasizing the need for users to manage expectations and potentially adjust outputs post-generation. No code changes were made; this is purely a documentation improvement.

items.title: Implement Payment Health Monitoring in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new CronJob that monitors payment attempts and successes across all payment channels. If a payment method has three or more attempts but zero successes within a 24-hour window, it triggers an alert to ensure silent outages are detected. This enhancement aims to improve visibility into payment failures, addressing a critical blind spot in the previous monitoring setup.

items.title: Gemini Docs Sync Verified — No Changes Needed in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: The recent upstream Docs sync identified `gemini` as a changed service, but an investigation confirmed that there are no Gemini MCP servers in this monorepo. Key findings include the absence of a `gemini/` subdirectory and no relevant mappings in `sync.yaml`, ensuring no code changes are necessary. As a result, this issue can be closed as already in sync.

items.title: Streamline Chat Models by Removing Image Options in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update removes three image models from the chat model list, addressing compatibility issues with the upstream service. The CLI will now directly reject requests for these models, preventing unnecessary failures. Additionally, the README has been updated to guide users towards the native API for image generation.

items.title: Refine model enum for chat/completions in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes three image models from the `chat/completions` enum, as they are not supported by any upstream services. The changes include modifications to the OpenAPI and cost API files, ensuring that the model collection remains stable while improving clarity in the code comments. Overall, the impact on billing and testing is minimal, with all tests passing successfully.

items.title: Implement Soft Cutoff for Deployment Services in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new soft cutoff mechanism for deployment services, allowing users to maintain their pods active even after expiration. Users can now renew their service instantly without losing their session, addressing previous issues of abrupt shutdowns and session loss. The changes are designed to enhance user experience and service continuity.

items.title: Clean Up Dead Code in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the entirely unused `responsesShim.js` file and associated dead code from `server.js`, resulting in a net deletion of 1251 lines. Additionally, it migrates the `parseModelList` function and introduces direct tests for it, ensuring that the codebase remains clean and maintainable. The changes enhance the overall reliability of the test suite by eliminating tests that were covering non-executed code.

items.title: Enhance Codex Tool Support for Consistency Testing in Platform Service 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces support for Codex's code mode tools, addressing issues where certain tool types were not recognized, leading to failures in file operations. Key changes include modifications to the inbound and outbound processing logic to correctly parse and handle `additional_tools`, `custom`, and `namespace` types. Comprehensive live tests have been added to ensure conformance with the official OpenAPI specifications.

items.title: Update Default Model to Chirp V5.5 in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The default model for the Suno CLI has been updated from chirp-v4-5 to chirp-v5-5. Key changes include updates to the configuration files, README, and test assertions to reflect this new default. This change will affect users who do not specify a model and do not set the SUNO_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable.

items.title: Reverted privacy contact details update in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reverts the recent changes made to the privacy documentation regarding contact details. The previous version included a link to the support page, which has now been replaced with direct contact information for the support team. This change aims to streamline communication for users seeking assistance.

items.title: Streamlined Risk Management for Restricted Applications in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update merges the risk management process for disabling restricted applications into AuthBackend, enhancing efficiency by eliminating the need for separate CronJobs. The new system allows for immediate action on flagged accounts, ensuring that free credits are reclaimed promptly. Key files related to the old process have been removed, and the necessary adjustments have been made to maintain functionality.

items.title: Streamlined Risk Management Pipeline for Enhanced Efficiency in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update merges three separate CronJobs into a single streamlined pipeline for risk management, significantly reducing the time between decision-making and execution. Key enhancements include the addition of a new rule layer that operates independently of the model, ensuring that blatant cases of abuse are flagged immediately. The changes also improve database interactions and eliminate redundant jobs, optimizing overall system performance.

items.title: Reverted support contacts update in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reverts the recent changes made to the support documentation, restoring the previous contact information layout. Key additions include multiple contact methods such as Discord, X, and email, ensuring users can easily reach out for support. The documentation now reflects the original structure, enhancing clarity for users seeking assistance.

items.title: Fix transient error handling for voice creation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses an issue where network-level errors were not being retried correctly during voice creation. The solution involves wrapping the error handling to ensure that only whitelisted errors are processed for retries, while others are thrown as is. New tests have been added to validate the behavior, ensuring that the system remains robust and functional.

items.title: Suno MCP Server Verified Against OpenAPI Spec in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: The verification process confirmed that the Suno MCP server's models, endpoints, and parameters are fully aligned with the current OpenAPI specification. Key components such as enums, action values, and request parameters were thoroughly checked, revealing no discrepancies. As a result, no code changes were necessary, ensuring seamless integration with the documentation.

items.title: Launch of Capability-First Product Tour in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new capability-first product tour at the `/intro` page, showcasing the platform's functionalities across six sections, including AI chat, images, video, music, production, and tools. The tour features localized screenshots and model cards, enhancing user understanding of available features. Additionally, the layout has been thoroughly audited for quality assurance, ensuring a seamless experience across multiple devices and languages.

items.title: Fix substring rules to ensure exact model pricing in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update reorders the rules in `_chat_models.json` to prevent substring rules from overshadowing exact model pricing. The changes correct billing discrepancies for three models, ensuring accurate charges moving forward. A new regression test has been added to maintain the integrity of the pricing rules.

items.title: Enhance Gemini Probes to Exclude Image Models in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the Gemini end-to-end probes to utilize `stable_text_models()`, effectively excluding image models from text prompt evaluations. As a result, the number of models used in the chat enum decreases from 12 to 7, reducing false failure rates and improving monitoring accuracy. The change does not affect production functionality or pricing, focusing solely on internal probe adjustments.

items.title: Fix audio upload retry logic and name handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves issues with the audio upload retry mechanism, ensuring that 'Audio upload failed' errors are now retried correctly in the ttapi. Additionally, it fixes the problem where the caller's name was being discarded, allowing user-supplied names to be retained in the response. These changes enhance the reliability of voice cloning operations and improve user experience.

items.title: Update PostCSS to Latest Version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps PostCSS from version 8.5.20 to 8.5.25, addressing several bugs and improving functionality. Key fixes include resolving a visitor regression and ensuring proper handling of non-string values in list.split(). These enhancements will contribute to a more stable and efficient development experience.

items.title: Enhance suno CLI with new generate options in Clis 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces new command options to the suno CLI's generate command, aligning it with the latest OpenAPI spec. Users can now specify vocal gender, negative styles, style influence, and audio weight, enhancing the customization of audio generation. Additionally, tests have been added to ensure these new options correctly map to the request fields.

items.title: Suno MCP Server Audit Confirms No Drift in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: An audit was conducted to verify that the Suno MCP server's models, endpoints, and parameters align with the OpenAPI specification. All 13 endpoints were cross-checked, and it was confirmed that there is no drift between the implementation and the spec. As a result, no code changes were necessary.

items.title: Clarify Duration Contract Details in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the documentation regarding the `duration` parameter in the audio generation API. Key changes include restoring the `10-360` range and custom mode as essential parts of the contract, while removing misleading phrases about variability. The documentation now accurately reflects the service's capabilities and limitations.

items.title: Clarified Duration Contract Details in Backend 🎶
items.summary: This update revises the documentation regarding the `duration` parameter for the Suno audio generation service. Key changes include restoring the valid range of 10-360 seconds, clarifying that the duration is a hint rather than a strict requirement, and correcting previous inaccuracies about model capabilities. These adjustments aim to provide clearer expectations for users regarding audio generation outcomes.

items.title: Comprehensive Capability Testing and Index Registration in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update includes a thorough verification of 52 capabilities on the white-label platform, with 48 passing and 4 identified issues, including one genuine bug and a data leak. Key changes involve enhanced testing coverage for various site paths, ensuring all functionalities are properly configured and verified. The findings have been documented in detail, providing insights into the testing methodology and results.

items.title: Suno MCP Verified Against OpenAPI Spec in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: The Suno MCP has been successfully verified to align with the latest OpenAPI specification from the Docs repository. All endpoints and model enums were checked, confirming no discrepancies and ensuring that all required request parameters are present. This verification ensures the integrity of the Suno service without necessitating any code changes.

items.title: Updated Privacy Contact Details in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the contact information in the privacy policy to direct users to the support page instead of displaying specific email and address details. The changes ensure that the privacy policy remains compliant while allowing each tenant to manage their own contact channels. The legal entity remains unchanged to maintain accountability.

items.title: Fix XML Issues in Quoted Links and Document Gaps in Wisdom 🛠️
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where the `quoted_text` in card references contained raw XML, which could disrupt LLM prompts. Additionally, it clarifies documentation regarding the `golden-promote` process, highlighting that it only affects new tenants and does not update service blueprints. Three new tests have been added to ensure the correct behavior of these changes.

items.title: Resolved Endpoint Misuse and Testing Results in Index 🤖
items.summary: This update clarifies the root cause of previous misjudgments regarding the `anthropic` provider, confirming that the issue stemmed from using the wrong endpoint rather than a platform defect. Additionally, the merged changes have been validated with successful online retests, showing consistent results across multiple tool and LLM calls, with significant cost savings from caching. Documentation has been updated to reflect these findings.

items.title: Align suno CLI with Latest OpenAPI Updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures the suno CLI is fully synchronized with the latest OpenAPI contract, addressing potential API-surface drift. Key changes include updated command definitions, aligned request options, and corrected endpoint mappings. Additionally, command help text has been refreshed for improved user guidance, and tests have been adjusted to reflect the new command behavior.

items.title: Updated Pricing Snapshots for Kimi K2 Models in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the pricing snapshots for the Kimi K2 models following a significant price reduction. The new prices ensure that all alternatives remain cheaper than the original models, maintaining the pricing safety invariant. Additionally, the snapshot date has been corrected to reflect the latest changes.

items.title: Sync Suno MCP schema updates with OpenAPI changes in M C Ps 🔄
items.summary: Updated the Suno MCP service to match the latest Docs OpenAPI contract, including request and response shapes, endpoint mappings, and parameter handling. Added newly supported model enum values while keeping existing aliases for compatibility. Changes were limited to the Suno service scope without unrelated refactors.

items.title: Major Cost Adjustments for Kimi K2 Models in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update implements significant price reductions for the Kimi K2 series, aligning API billing to a baseline of 40% of the official price. The pricing page has been corrected to reflect accurate display prices, ensuring consistency with actual discounts. Additionally, a new test has been added to enforce the business rule that prices must not exceed official rates.

items.title: Enhance WebSocket E2E Testing in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive end-to-end test for the WebSocket functionality, ensuring that clients receive messages correctly. Key improvements include hard imports for dependencies and updates to the README documentation regarding the release process. The CI pipeline now includes explicit tests that validate the entire message flow, enhancing reliability and reducing silent failures.

items.title: Restore Crypto Top-Ups with Client Update in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the x402-client version to 2026.804.0, addressing a critical issue that caused 100% failure in online crypto top-ups for 13 days. The fix includes the necessary EIP712Domain declaration, which was missing in the previous version, ensuring successful transaction signatures and restoring functionality for users.

items.title: Strengthened Kimi Caching Tests in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the testing framework for Kimi's caching billing system without altering any billing rules. Key changes include dynamic reading of prompt coefficients to prevent hard-coded drift and the addition of a new test to ensure that cached billing never results in negative amounts. These improvements aim to maintain consistency and reliability in billing calculations.

items.title: Kimi Code CLI Integration Report: Full Cycle Validation in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update presents a comprehensive end-to-end verification of the Kimi Code CLI with AceDataCloud, confirming its functionality as an OpenAI-compatible backend. Key findings include successful task execution with consistent token counting and billing accuracy, alongside the identification of a pricing gap and security concerns regarding API key exposure. The report adds valuable documentation without altering any existing code or configurations.

items.title: Enhance suno CLI with title and style options in Clis 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces `--title` and `--style` options to the `suno generate` command, aligning it with the existing API request schema. These parameters allow users to specify the title and music style for generated audio, enhancing the command's functionality. A regression test has also been added to ensure these options are correctly included in the outgoing request.

items.title: Suno CLI is perfectly in sync with OpenAPI spec in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The recent verification confirmed that the Suno CLI aligns seamlessly with the updated OpenAPI specification. All 13 paths and corresponding commands were compared, and no discrepancies were found, ensuring that the CLI reflects the current API accurately. This means no code changes were necessary, maintaining a smooth user experience.

items.title: Update duration constraints and model limits in M C Ps 🎶
items.summary: This update corrects the duration constraints for the `suno_generate_custom_music` function and revises the model limit table in the documentation. The duration is now strictly defined for specific model and action combinations, ensuring clearer expectations for users. Additionally, the prompt and title limits have been updated to reflect accurate values for each model, enhancing the overall clarity of the API documentation.

items.title: Update duration parameter details in Backend 🎶
items.summary: This update corrects the documentation for the `duration` parameter in the Suno audio generation feature. It clarifies that the parameter is a hint rather than a strict limit, and updates the conditions under which it operates, reflecting recent code changes. The documentation now accurately describes the expected behavior and potential variations in output length.

items.title: Revamp Support Contacts for Better Tenant Experience in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes hardcoded contact information from the shared support document, addressing issues with tenant-specific support channels. The contact details are now dynamically provided through the Site branding schema, ensuring each tenant can direct customers to their own support resources. Additionally, the document link has been updated to a relative path to prevent redirection to the main site.

items.title: Enhanced Voice Cloning Error Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a retry mechanism for transient voice cloning errors, improving user experience by reducing unnecessary failures. Key changes include the implementation of a classification system for errors and a new retry logic that conserves resources while allowing for a second attempt on certain failures. The expected impact is a recovery of approximately 9% of previously failed requests within budget constraints.

items.title: Move support contacts to site configuration in Frontend Web 🔧
items.summary: Updated the support page to render contact details only from per-site branding configuration instead of shared document content. Simplified the contact visibility logic, added QR contact rendering support, and removed the old shared contact filtering approach. Updated ownership checks to enforce the new single-source contact model.

items.title: Fix Kimi Cache Pricing Calculation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update recalculates the Kimi K3 cached discount coefficient after rebasing on the latest main branch. The new coefficient is adjusted from -31.968 to -10.8, ensuring accurate billing and preventing potential losses. All tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Fix EIP712Domain Declaration for Typed Data in X402 Client 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the `EIP712Domain` was not declared in the typed data, leading to a 13-day outage for crypto top-ups. Key changes include the addition of complete domain declarations for both `exact` and `upto` types, ensuring compatibility with MetaMask and ethers. All tests are now passing, and the next step involves releasing a new npm package to fully resolve the issue.

items.title: Enhance Suno CLI Documentation and Sync Verification in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies the Suno CLI's synchronization with the latest OpenAPI spec, confirming that all endpoints and request fields are correctly implemented. Key documentation updates include the addition of the `suno inspo <audio_id>` command and the `--duration` option for track length specification. These changes enhance usability and ensure alignment with the current API standards.

items.title: Upgrade Node setup workflow dependency in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: Updated GitHub Actions workflows to use actions/setup-node version 7 instead of version 6. The change applies to CI and extension release workflows while continuing to configure the same Node.js versions and npm caching behavior. This keeps the frontend automation workflows aligned with the latest setup-node release.

items.title: Revive WebSocket Message Publishing in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update restores the message publishing functionality for the `/ws` endpoint, which had been inactive since the removal of WeChat 3.x code. A new message pump has been implemented to poll the WeChat database every 3 seconds, ensuring that clients receive real-time updates without requiring any changes on their end. Additionally, comprehensive tests have been added to verify the reliability of the message delivery system.

items.title: Stabilized risk agent startup and hardened CronJob validation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: Fixed risk agent startup failures by pinning marshmallow below version 4 and supplying required placeholder settings for the CronJob environment. Added deployment regression tests to verify required settings, dependency compatibility, and credential placeholder usage. The dry-run completed successfully with the agent reviewing domains and producing risk decisions.

items.title: Verified Suno MCP sync with OpenAPI spec in M C Ps ✅
items.summary: Checked the Suno MCP server implementation against the updated Docs OpenAPI specification. Confirmed that models, actions, endpoints, and request parameters are already fully aligned with the spec. No code changes were required because the existing implementation already covers the update.

items.title: Enhance Duration Parameter Documentation in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the `duration` parameter in the English API documentation, adding clarity on its usage and behavior. Key points include the distinction between request and response durations, and the handling of out-of-contract requests which now return explicit errors instead of being silently ignored. A runnable Python example is also included to aid developers.

items.title: Enhance Custom Command with Duration Option in Clis 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces the `--duration` option to the custom command, allowing users to set a target track length between 10 and 360 seconds. The change ensures that the duration is only applicable in custom mode, preventing unnecessary errors in the generate command. Comprehensive tests have been added to verify the correct payload handling for both set and unset duration values.

items.title: Enhance Suno Tool with Duration Parameter in Dify 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces a new `duration` parameter to the Suno generation tool, allowing users to specify track lengths between 10 and 360 seconds. The parameter is declared as a number type, with internal handling to ensure it is treated as an integer. Comprehensive checks have been performed to validate the implementation across various input scenarios.

items.title: Empower Users with Custom Track Length in Nexior 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces a new track-length control in the Suno advanced parameters panel, allowing users to specify durations between 10 to 360 seconds for custom-mode generations. The feature is off by default and can be enabled via a switch, ensuring existing users maintain their current settings unless they opt in. Additionally, internationalization support has been added for 18 locales, enhancing accessibility for a broader audience.

items.title: Enhance Suno Clients with Duration Parameter in SDK 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a new `duration` parameter to the Suno provider across TypeScript, Python, and Go, allowing users to specify track lengths between 10 and 360 seconds. The change is part of a broader rollout and includes modifications to the generated client files, ensuring compatibility with existing functionality. All code checks have passed successfully, confirming the stability of the update.

items.title: Enhance Duration Parameter Documentation in Skills 📚
items.summary: This update documents the `duration` parameter as part of the rollout, adding it to the advanced-parameter table and including a gotcha entry. Key clarifications highlight the requirement for all three conditions to avoid errors and explain the distinction between the target and actual duration of clips. These changes aim to improve user understanding and implementation of the parameter.

items.title: Enhance Custom Music Generation with Duration Parameter in M C Ps 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces a new `duration` parameter to the `suno_generate_custom_music` function, allowing users to specify the target track length between 10 and 360 seconds. The change ensures that the parameter is only included in the API payload when set, improving the clarity of requests. Additionally, the model table has been updated to clarify the distinction between the maximum duration for unguided generation and the new parameter's limits.

items.title: Enhance Suno API with Duration Parameter in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `duration` parameter to the Suno API, allowing users to specify the desired length of audio tracks. The new parameter is documented in the OpenAPI specification and the development guide, ensuring clarity on its usage and constraints. This change addresses a previous issue where the parameter was accepted but ignored, enhancing the overall functionality of the audio generation process.

items.title: Enhance Duration Control for Suno in Platform Service 🎶
items.summary: This update introduces support for a custom-mode duration parameter in the Suno audio generation process. Now, users can specify a duration between 10 and 360 seconds, which is correctly forwarded to upstream services, addressing a previous issue where the parameter was ignored. Additionally, the update includes new tests to ensure functionality and compliance with the expected behavior.

items.title: Upgrade Extension Minimum Version to 0.7.33 in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update raises the minimum browser extension version from 0.7.8 to 0.7.33 to prevent broken builds caused by outdated versions. Key changes include modifications to the settings and deployment files, ensuring that only compatible versions are allowed. The upgrade aims to enhance stability and user experience by enforcing a more stringent version requirement.

items.title: Enhance AuthBackend Error Reporting in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the error reporting for authentication failures in the browser relay by including specific cause codes. Previously, users faced infinite reconnection loops without understanding the reason for rejection. Now, the system logs detailed cause codes, allowing for better diagnostics and user experience.

items.title: Enhance Payment Failure Logging in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the logging for payment verification and settlement failures in the X402 system. It adds warning logs that capture essential details such as the reason for failure and transaction specifics, ensuring better visibility for troubleshooting. Additionally, new tests have been implemented to validate the logging functionality and ensure no sensitive information is exposed.

items.title: Enhance Payment Rejection Logging in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces detailed logging for payment rejections, capturing critical information such as the rejection reason, payer type, and signature details. By logging these elements, it significantly improves the diagnostics process, allowing for quicker triage of issues related to signature failures. The changes include modifications to the verification process and the addition of new tests to ensure reliability.

items.title: Sync CLI Tools with Latest OpenAPI Updates in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the `aichat`, `kimi`, and `suno` CLIs with the most recent OpenAPI changes, ensuring command coverage and accurate request shapes. Key adjustments include updated command options, corrected endpoint paths, and refreshed help summaries to reflect the latest API operations. The existing CLI architecture remains intact while enhancing compatibility with the updated specifications.

items.title: Sync and Verify Aichat, Kimi, and Suno Models in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the Aichat, Kimi, and Suno models are in sync with the latest documentation. Key changes include the removal of four retired Kimi K2 models and the addition of a new test to prevent these models from reappearing. The verification confirms that all endpoints and models are aligned with the specifications, enhancing the reliability of our API.

items.title: Streamline Kimi Model Table by Removing Zero-Traffic Models in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update removes four Kimi K2 models from the ai-chat SKILL.md documentation due to zero real calls over the past week. The models `kimi-k2-instruct-0905`, `kimi-k2-0905-preview`, `kimi-k2-turbo-preview`, and `kimi-k2-0711-preview` have been identified as inactive and are no longer listed. The remaining models, including `kimi-k3` and others, continue to be supported.

items.title: Streamline AiChat Models by Removing Zero-Traffic Kimi K2s in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update removes four Kimi K2 models from the public types in AiChatV2Model due to zero traffic over the past week. The models removed are `kimi-k2-instruct-0905`, `kimi-k2-turbo-preview`, `kimi-k2-0905-preview`, and `kimi-k2-0711-preview`. The remaining models continue to be supported, ensuring a more efficient model management system.

items.title: Retire unused Kimi K2 models and update pricing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update removes four zero-traffic Kimi K2 models from the fallback configuration, ensuring a cleaner model management. Additionally, the pricing for Kimi K3 has been updated to reflect new rates, while maintaining price safety across fallback targets. The changes have been validated with successful test results.

items.title: Significant Cost Reduction for Kimi-K3 in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update implements a major price drop for the Kimi-K3 model, reducing input and output coefficients significantly. The new pricing aligns with official rates, offering a 40% reduction, which is expected to enhance customer acquisition. Additionally, the maximum credits have been adjusted to maintain consistent token usage without impacting real-world performance.

items.title: Retire Unused Kimi K2 Models in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes four Kimi K2 legacy models that have shown zero real traffic over the past week. The models were only called by internal probes and do not impact the fallback mechanisms, ensuring system reliability. Key files have been updated to reflect these changes, streamlining the model configuration and billing rules.

items.title: Refactor WeChat Integration Card for Product-Specific Display in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update refactors the WeChat integration card to ensure it only displays for relevant products, addressing a critical bug in the rendering conditions. The card has been moved to a more appropriate location, and its naming has been updated to reflect its specific purpose. Additionally, outdated translations across multiple locales have been corrected to align with the new terminology.
